There are two reasons trucks and SUVs typically receive higher cash offers than sedans.
First, they weigh more — scrap metal prices are calculated by weight, so a 5,000-pound truck is worth more than a 3,000-pound sedan on scrap value alone.
Engines, transmissions, transfer cases, axles, and body panels from popular trucks often have significant resale value even when the vehicle as a whole isn't worth repairing.
We'll give you a firm offer immediately.
We always bring the right truck for the job, and towing is always free — even for heavy-duty trucks and full-size SUVs.

For SUVs, the most common are Jeep Grand Cherokee, Jeep Wrangler, Ford Explorer, Ford Expedition, Chevrolet Tahoe, Chevrolet Suburban, Toyota 4Runner, Honda Pilot, and Dodge Durango.
